_comment: WORKSHOPS PAGE COPY (English). REPOSITIONING (2026-09-16): Taqathon 2026's hackathon was postponed and this page — file/URL still named 'schedule' to avoid an unnecessary URL change, same reasoning as every other migration in this project — was renamed 'Workshops' and made the primary destination for the new remote-workshop-series direction. 'intro' is adapted from the association's own official description of the series (three interconnected areas, applied/interactive focus). The 3 real workshops below are the exact lineup the user supplied directly (2026-09-16): dates are DAY/MONTH ONLY as given, deliberately with NO YEAR — inventing one (even though 'Taqathon 2026' branding makes 2026 a reasonable guess) would break this project's flag-don't-invent rule, so it's listed in PROGRESS.md as something to confirm. Exact start times and the remote session platform/link are also unconfirmed — flagged via workshopsNote/ed-note below instead of guessed. Workshop 3 genuinely has no separate moderator in the source material (3 speakers only) — 'moderator' is null on purpose, not an oversight; schedule.njk skips rendering that row when null. The old hackathon-phase 'keyDates' timeline (registration/screening/mentorship/winners) no longer reflects the current plan and is NOT rendered anymore (see schedule.njk), but is kept below rather than deleted in case a version of it is needed again once the program's next phase is decided.
intro: A remote training series for university students, spanning three interconnected areas — energy, AI, and project management — with an applied, interactive focus that connects theory to real-world challenges.
workshopsNote: Exact start times and the remote session link haven't been confirmed yet — they'll be added here once available.
